policy_presence.summary: HKUST publishes course-level AI authority, responsible-use and academic-integrity rules. Academic, examination and research procedures have distinct scopes.

coursework.summary: Follow the instructor’s written GenAI policy for the specific course. Faculty choose the policy and must notify students in writing; Registry says syllabi should state it. Unauthorized assistance and fabricated facts/references remain misconduct.

exams.summary: Under examination-condition rules, electronic devices including AI smart glasses must be beyond access unless explicitly permitted. Thesis and final-year-project examinations are excluded from these rules; course-specific instructions still matter.

ai_disclosure.summary: ITSO recommends acknowledging or labelling AI content when appropriate. Follow the actual course’s attribution and permitted-assistance rules; acknowledgement does not authorize a prohibited use.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Avoid confidential, sensitive and personal inputs. Desensitization guidance for confidential university documents in commercial tools is not blanket permission for all personal data. Open WebUI states30-day chat history; other logs and vendor retention are not established.

academic_integrity.summary: Unauthorized assistance and fabrication may trigger student misconduct procedures. Grade review uses10 working days from release, accepted review within15 working days from release, and Dean appeal10 working days from receipt of the department decision. Misconduct appeals have separate14-calendar-day written-notification clocks.

approved_tools.summary: ITSO offers distinct tools and accounts. Gemini Enterprise EDU includes individual student subscriptions or programme sponsorship; staff M365 Copilot needs a paid additional licence. GenAI Platform is listed as a hosted institutional service, not user self-deployment. Access is not assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Gemini Enterprise EDU, Copilot Chat and paid M365 Copilot have distinct campus eligibility and authentication. No-training commitments do not establish no storage or unrestricted uploads.

teaching_guidance.summary: Faculty set and communicate course AI policies. CEI advises assessment design that does not rely solely on AI-text detectors; this is not an institutional detector ban. Restricted guidebook/report full texts remain unavailable.

research_guidance.summary: Research-integrity and award-related student misconduct follow distinct routes. For UROP reports, AI may support consultation but not the final write-up; supervisor conditions and research privacy/ethics still apply.

security_procurement.summary: Public guidance establishes data-protection cautions, but does not establish a complete procurement/security-approval or vendor-log retention process. Consult the exact service and institutional requirements.
